method.snapshot: sealed DefiLlama protocol snapshot (category, tvl, chains, listed tokens, parent/child links)
method.tokenless_rule: protocol records no token and no token symbol in the snapshot
method.wrapped_staked_rule: excluded when the protocol is a wrapped or staked derivative of a token that already trades (name/symbol match against the snapshot's token index, plus explicit wrapped/staked/restaked/derivative markers)
method.implied_value: tvl_usd * category_launch_multiple * chain_diversification_bonus * revenue_quality_factor, rounded to nearest 100k
method.ranking: implied_value_usd descending, ties broken by tvl_usd then slug

steps: Bridge or swap a small seed (0.05-0.2 ETH equivalent) onto the protocol's primary chain
Complete any quest or points registration the protocol publishes before interacting
Provide liquidity or lend into the deepest pool, keeping at least 60% of capital in the base asset
Hold the position across at least two epochs or snapshots so points accrue
Track the protocol's announced snapshot dates and claim any testnet or early-bird allocation
Exit or rebalance once the token event is confirmed and liquidity thins
